services.desc: Experience the ultimate Johns Pass Sandbar adventure with our private party boat charters departing from Madeira Beach near St. Petersburg. Cruise to the famous sandbar on a fully captained double-decker boat with water slides, premium sound, and plenty of room to celebrate. Perfect for bachelorettes, birthdays, and group outings-choose your vibe and let’s make it an unforgettable day on the water. Make sure to pack sunscreen, towels, swimwear, and any personal items you need. Don't forget your favorite drinks (BYOB)! We provide coolers, but bring your own ice to keep them
